rewritten.oldTeachingObjective: Finish available side when GK near arm high (template, no real cue use)
rewritten.newTeachingObjective: Near arm stays high before take-off → finish low under that arm, not a blind far-post

rewritten.oldTeachingObjective: Generic free finish in 2v1 with stock A/B
rewritten.newTeachingObjective: In 2v1 hold the wide lane as the pass option until the CB fixes the lone defender
Pressure catch in transition: secure first, short return, do not force take-off

rewritten.oldTeachingObjective: Stock short return when transition finish gone
rewritten.newTeachingObjective: No clean transition finish: short secure continuation, not a forced wing shot
6v5 with covered take-off: short return — numerical advantage is not an automatic finish
In 5v6 hold width as safe release — do not force the corner into a home wing defender
7v6 with second pivot binding middle: finish when wing defender steps inside and lane opens
7v6 but wing still covered: short return — extra attacker elsewhere is not your finish

perception.justification: Perception=true only when primary task is reading an observable cue (hips, arms, recovery distance, block geometry, handover state, covered take-off, GK body) before deciding. Score/minute/6v5 label alone is insufficient.
